title: Polynomial functors in π-clans for the semantics of type theory
summary: The category of contexts underlying a model of Martin-Löf type theory with Unit-, $Σ$-, and $Π$-types need not be locally Cartesian closed, but is necessarily a $π$-clan. We exploit this $π$-clan structure to build the theory of polynomial functors. This paper presents two equivalent notions of strict semantics for MLTT in this weaker setting, respectively "elementary models" - reformulating categories with families - and "algebraic models" - reformulating natural models.
